mutations.name: the shepherd section drops its error branch
mutations.find: if ("error" in input) return { error: input.error };

mutations.name: the shepherd section counts every run as a review in flight
kills: tallies runs by phase, lists held runs and counts reviews in flight against the cap

mutations.name: the worktree ceiling ignores left-free
kills: subtracts left-free from the ceiling and repeats the per-repo cap on each repo
